description.zh: 经 LiteLLM 网关驱动 Meshy 的 AI 小物件 3D 低模资产生成：文/图/多图 → lowpoly mesh → (可选 refine PBR 纹理) → (可选 remesh 降面) → glb → 落盘游戏可用资产。区别于 wb-3d-lowpoly（程序化 CAD）。
description.en: LiteLLM-gateway-driven Meshy generator for small 3D lowpoly props: text/image/multi-image → lowpoly mesh → (optional refine PBR) → (optional remesh) → glb → durable game asset. Distinct from wb-3d-lowpoly (programmatic CAD).

description.zh: 读取 Meshy 网关配置 + COS 状态（网关无余额端点）；返回静态、无配额数据。
description.en: Read Meshy gateway config + COS state (gateway has no balance endpoint). Static, no quota.

description.zh: 文生低模（默认 precise-lowpoly：standard 生成 → 减面到目标面数 → 可选 PBR 重贴图）→ 落盘持久 manifest。未配置 Meshy 时回退确定性 mock。
description.en: Text-to-lowpoly (default precise-lowpoly: standard generate → remesh to target → optional PBR retexture) → durable manifest. Mock fallback when Meshy unconfigured.

description.zh: 图生低模（默认 precise-lowpoly 管线, 单图, 需 COS 中转）→ 落盘持久 manifest。
description.en: Image-to-lowpoly (default precise-lowpoly pipeline, single image, COS relay) → durable manifest.

description.zh: 多视角生低模（默认 precise-lowpoly 管线, 多图, 需 COS 中转）→ 落盘持久 manifest。
description.en: Multi-image-to-lowpoly (default precise-lowpoly pipeline, multi-view, COS relay) → durable manifest.

description.zh: 给 preview 低模加 PBR 纹理（Meshy text-to-3d mode:refine）→ 新持久 manifest。
description.en: Add PBR texture to a preview lowpoly (Meshy text-to-3d mode:refine) → new durable manifest.

description.zh: 给已有模型换风格 PBR 纹理（Meshy retexture）→ 新持久 manifest。
description.en: Restyle an existing model with PBR texture (Meshy retexture) → new durable manifest.

description.zh: 对已有 Meshy 任务结果重拓扑降面到 target polycount（Meshy remesh）→ 新持久 manifest。
description.en: Remesh an existing Meshy task result to target polycount (Meshy remesh) → new durable manifest.

description.zh: 本地图片上传 COS（中转产物,非资产）→ 24h presigned URL 供 Meshy URL-fetch。未配置 COS 报 cos_not_configured。
description.en: Upload local image to COS (transfer artifact, NOT an asset) → 24h presigned URL for Meshy URL-fetch. Errors cos_not_configured if COS unset.

description.zh: 列出当前游戏已生成的 props 3D 资产 manifest。
description.en: List the active game's generated props 3D asset manifests.

description.zh: 只读：查询该资产的引擎身份证是否存在且对应当前 GLB 内容。
description.en: Read-only: check whether the engine identity meta exists and matches the current GLB content.

description.zh: 导入到游戏：必要时规范化 Draco → 办/重办引擎身份证，使 Edit 资产面板认得出。
description.en: Import to Game: normalize Draco if needed → cook/re-cook engine identity meta so the Edit asset panel recognizes it.

description.zh: 读取网关 + COS 凭证掩码配置状态（网关 key 由 Studio 设置统一管理，不返回明文）。
description.en: Read masked gateway + COS credential state (gateway key managed in Studio Settings; no plaintext).

description.zh: 写入/更新 COS 凭证 + 总开关到插件本地 .env 并即时生效（Meshy 网关 key 由 Studio 设置统一管理，此处不可写）。
description.en: Write/update COS credentials + master switch to plugin-local .env, applied live. The Meshy gateway key is managed in Studio Settings and is not writable here.
